why:
Checks 1, 2, 3 and 5 test only what their expect lines say. Two checks go further than their lines:
- Check 4's line says only "lint(text) in src/index.js is unchanged". Its FAIL condition is "any diff in lint (or the file) shown", and its command diffs the whole file. That is a file-scope rule the words don't require: a comment changed elsewhere in src/index.js would fail it even if lint() is unchanged.
- Check 6's PASS requires "the PR is open on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test". The expect line only says the change is one PR on that repo. It never says the PR must be open, so a merged PR would fail a test the words don't require.
Both stricter conditions belong under Advisory, not in PASS or FAIL, so the criterion is not met.
